title: Unit Event — Live with Memories — Episode3 What We Can Do

meta.Event Outline: The wind is in Leo/need's sails as the band continues performing and starts to build its own fanbase. But then, they encounter a brother and sister, who are Leo/need fans, having an argument.

rows.Line: The next day
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Nice.
They're all in sync today!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, and handling the difficult parts without any issues. However...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It seems like something's on all of their minds...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Phew...
Miku, Luka, how was that just now?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, um...
That was very good.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yay!
Luka praised us!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Practicing solo seems to have really paid off.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I think so too.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
(Something's definitely bothering them.
They just don't seem like their usual selves...)

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hey, quit being so clingy!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Aww, don't say that!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh? Len, Rin, what's going on?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Another fight?
What did we tell you about...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
We're not fighting!
I was just asking Len to practice with me, but he keeps turning me down!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Didn't I already tell you that I want to practice on my own today? And you just keep following me around...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Because I really want to practice with you, Len! Being apart is just way too sad!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Being apart? What are you talking about? But fine... Just this once, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Really?!
Thank you so much Len-Len☆

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Geez, and you came up with a weird nickname for me...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Weird? You don't think it's cute?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe. Those two really do get along, don't they?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah, they really do.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Did something happen to all of you?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It seemed like something was on all of your minds the entire time you were playing just now...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, about that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're a little worried about a couple of people who've been coming to see our shows...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: As in audience members?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes.
They're our very first fans, but they seem to be struggling with some issues at home...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: At the same time, we probably shouldn't be nosing around in another family's business...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But we can't help but worry...
I mean, they're our very first fans, and...

rows.Speaker: Yota
rows.Line: Never see her... Again...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Never getting to see someone you care about so much ever again sounds so awful...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But you can't help but worry about them regardless of whether or not you can do anything about it, right?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: At the same time, it's also understandable that you'd feel this way after dwelling on something like this for so long.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Still, I think it's okay to worry if it's genuinely bothering you all that much.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, especially since it'll start affecting the way we play if this continues...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
True.
Thank you, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
And... Can you tell us more about what happened?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, after our show the other day...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That really happened...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Isn't there any way we can help them...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: One can only hope...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: But the brother said he won't be returning, so there's no guarantee that his sister will come back to see us again...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Which means you won't get a chance to hear more from them...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That's terrible! You finally have some fans but they have to go through this awful mess!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're right about it being a tough situation...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But the sister still wants to come to see us play again, right...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
I think so.
He even asked us to speak to her if she does show up.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: It might be good to have a plan for when that happens.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
A plan...?
But what...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: How about being ready to play for her in case she does show up...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: From the sound of it, she really likes seeing us play.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I agree...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
Let's make our next show a really good one!
After practice
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I still believe the bridge can sound better! What do you think, Shiho?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Having a more subdued sound gives the last chorus more impact. If anything, we have something to gain by having less.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I agree that it's a bit monotonous as it is, but we can work on that tomorrow...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Thank goodness.
They seem much better after getting back to practicing...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I need to do my best for our next show too!)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(But...
The brother must be feeling awful right now...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (Seeing those two reminds me of what happened back then.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (You want to be there with someone but can't.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I have to think that's what they're both feeling right now...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What's wrong, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Um, girls...
That person over there. Could it be...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: The sister?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
She's sitting all by herself.
You think something happened...?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: What if she's here to pass the time because she feels so uncomfortable at home...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
Wait, is she gonna be okay by herself?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh no...!

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line:
Excuse me!
Are you free to talk right now?

rows.Speaker: Woman B
rows.Line: We're doing a quick survey and were hoping that you'd be willing to answer a few questions.

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: Oh, um... I don't think I should...

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line:
It won't take any time at all.
Just ten minutes or so!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Isn't that...?

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line: I know. It's getting late, so how about we move to that cafe?

rows.Speaker: Woman B
rows.Line: Some of our friends are over there already. We usually study and watch movies together...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: They're being so forceful...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah, is it just me or does it look like they're trying to rope her into something?

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line:
Alright, let's go!
It's just this way!

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: W-Wait...! Please, let go of me...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Huh?! Ichi?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Excuse me!

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
She's here to meet us...
Can I ask who you are?

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line:
L-Leo/need...?!
No way...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If you have some business with her, I'll stay and listen. What exactly were you asking of her...?

rows.Speaker: Woman A
rows.Line: Oh, you were waiting for your friends...

rows.Speaker: Woman B
rows.Line:
That's too bad...
Feel free to drop in if you get a chance.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Thank goodness they didn't push back...

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line:
E-Excuse me...!
You're Hoshino, right...? From Leo/need...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Y-Yes!
Um...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(What do I do now...?
I jumped in without really thinking...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I even went as far as saying, “She's here to meet us.” She's probably petrified now...)

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: Um... Th-Thank you so much for saving me from them! Also...

rows.Speaker: Hanano
rows.Line: I'm sorry about what happened the other day...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh...?
